text:
cam: quick note — eu-west canary on notification-service is spiking 502s right after chart promotion. deploy-bot posted healthfail at 12:03
rita: saw it. Which overlay merged? Any values diffs?
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary health failure notification-service v5.1.0-canary (eu-west). Probe failures 5/12 in 2m. Annotations: overlays=[base,region-eu,feature-flags,staging-notes]
sylvia: staging-notes? That overlay tweaks the public basePath and appends a release-note URL to metadata. Could be changing routing.
cam: excerpt from merge diff:
```diff
@@
- basePath: /api
+ basePath: /api/v1
+ releaseNotesUrl: https://staging-notes.internal/example
```
oncall: releaseNotesUrl being present shouldn't break routing but basePath may cause upstream mismatch -> 502. Remediation: A) rollback to 5.0.9 (fast) B) values-only hotpatch removing basePath bump and releaseNotesUrl, then pin canary in eu-west for validation. Change window ~22m.
sylvia: prefer hotpatch to keep chart changes (5.1.0 had telemetry fix). I'll prepare hotfix-values to reset basePath and remove releaseNotesUrl. Also request deploy-bot pin for eu-west until e2e pass.
rita: please also add a small guard in overlay-merge: disallow releaseNotesUrl keys originating from overlays named *staging* when target=prod. I'll file PR after this.
cam: runbook snippet for hotpatch:
```bash
helm upgrade --install notification-service ./charts/notification -f values.yaml -f hotfix-reset-basepath.yaml --namespace prod-eu-west --set adopter=hotfix
kubectl rollout status deploy/notification-service -n prod-eu-west --timeout=120s
```
deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @sylvia: pin notification-service chart to 5.0.9 in eu-west until manual clear. Automated rollback not executed.
sylvia: hotfix applied -> 5.1.0-hotfix (values-only). Health probes recovered, smoke checks 200. Rolling e2e for 25m.
oncall: will monitor logs and latency. Keep pin for 30m.
rita: opened PR #5122 to add overlay-name guard + schema rule forbidding releaseNotesUrl in prod overlays unless flagged. Also adding a quick unit test.
cam: after validation, update release-notes: include an entry "fix(values): remove staging releaseNotesUrl and basePath mistakenly merged into prod overlay; caused routing 502s in eu-west canary" and link PR #5122.
sylvia: TL;DR: values hotfix done, canary pinned, follow-ups: overlay-merge guard + release-note line + update runbook to surface merged overlay list in deploy description. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Pin cleared by @oncall after validation window. (automated)
